summary: Minerals Technologies filed an 8-K announcing pricing of a $400 million private placement of 7.500% senior notes due 2032, expected to close October 13, 2026, subject to customary conditions. Concurrently, the company expects to amend its credit agreement, upsizing the revolver to $500 million and extending its maturity, with a springing maturity tied to the $575 million senior secured term loans. Proceeds are intended for general corporate purposes. This is a routine debt financing, not a special situation; watch leverage and refinancing risk.
